_meta.description: Machine-readable catalog of Irodori Table DB-specific feature samples, manual sample projects, verification commands, and official learning resources.

referenceBlogs.label: Beekeeper Studio Blog
referenceBlogs.note: Reference for practical database client workflows and product writing.

managedTargets.label: Amazon Aurora
whatYouCanDo: Connect to Aurora PostgreSQL with the PostgreSQL engine or Aurora MySQL with the MySQL engine.
Use standard DB client workflows against cluster, reader, writer, and custom endpoints.
Track Aurora-specific UX for cluster topology, reader endpoint selection, Performance Insights links, IAM auth, and serverless scaling.

managedTargets.label: Google Cloud SQL
whatYouCanDo: Connect with the existing PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server engines depending on the Cloud SQL instance type.
Use normal SQL browsing, query execution, metadata, and result history once networking and TLS are configured.
Track Cloud SQL-specific UX for public/private IP, Cloud SQL Auth Proxy, IAM database auth, SSL certs, and instance metadata.

features.title: Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL through Postgres wire
Cloud SQL for MySQL through MySQL wire
Cloud SQL for SQL Server through TDS

lakehouseTargets.label: Apache Iceberg
whatYouCanDo: Planned as a table-format/catalog source, not a SQL wire-compatible database.
Needs catalog connection support for REST, Hive Metastore, AWS Glue, JDBC catalogs, and external storage credentials.
Expected Irodori UX includes catalog/table browser, schema/partition/snapshot inspection, metadata-driven previews, and execution through DuckDB/Trino/Spark/Athena-style engines.

features.title: Snapshot, schema, partition, and manifest browser
Local execution path through DuckDB/DataFusion where possible

lakehouseTargets.label: Amazon S3 Tables
whatYouCanDo: Planned as a managed Iceberg target over AWS table buckets.
Needs S3 Tables/IAM/table-bucket discovery plus execution through Athena, Redshift, Spark, or compatible Iceberg engines.
Expected Irodori UX includes table bucket, namespace, table, snapshot, maintenance, and AWS analytics integration visibility.

features.title: Query through Athena, Redshift, Spark, or compatible engines

engines.label: PostgreSQL
whatYouCanDo: Run SQL through the native Postgres adapter.
Browse schemas, tables, views, columns, keys, indexes, comments, and row estimates.
Exercise JSONB, arrays, GIN indexes, extensions, generate_series, and explain output.

engines.label: MySQL
whatYouCanDo: Run MySQL SQL through sqlx's MySQL adapter.
Browse tables, views, routines, columns, indexes, and comments from information_schema.
Exercise JSON functions, foreign keys, window functions, and EXPLAIN FORMAT=JSON.

engines.label: SQLite
whatYouCanDo: Run local file or in-memory SQLite queries without a server.
Use SQLite as a lightweight embedded sample DB for UI and metadata work.
Exercise JSON functions, foreign keys, FTS5, and PRAGMA-based inspection.

engines.label: SQL Server
whatYouCanDo: Connect over TDS through the pure-Rust tiberius adapter.
Run T-SQL, inspect SQL Server metadata, and verify precision-safe values.
Exercise JSON_VALUE, identity columns, TOP, OFFSET/FETCH, and window functions.

engines.label: DuckDB
whatYouCanDo: Install the DuckDB connector extension to run local or in-memory analytical SQL without a server.
Use DuckDB as an extension-provided local analytics engine for files, generated data, and result exploration.
Exercise struct values, summarize, window functions, and EXPLAIN.

engines.label: MotherDuck
whatYouCanDo: Installable connector tracked separately from the embedded DuckDB adapter.
Attach MotherDuck cloud databases and browse cloud/local analytical tables through the DuckDB workflow.
Track token handling, database attach, hybrid local/cloud query execution, and cloud table discovery UX.

features.title: Cloud DuckDB attach and query workflow

engines.label: CockroachDB
whatYouCanDo: Connect through the Postgres wire adapter.
Run Cockroach SQL against a local single-node cluster.
Exercise unique_rowid, UPSERT, range inspection, and distributed SQL metadata.

engines.label: YugabyteDB
whatYouCanDo: Connect through the Postgres-compatible YSQL wire path.
Run YSQL queries against a local single-node YugabyteDB sample.
Exercise split tablets and YSQL table-property inspection.

engines.label: Amazon Redshift
whatYouCanDo: Connect through the Postgres wire path to a real AWS cluster.
Run warehouse SQL and inspect basic result sets.
Track Redshift-specific auth, COPY/UNLOAD, external schema, and system-view work as cloud-only follow-ups.

features.title: Postgres wire connection to AWS Redshift

engines.label: TimescaleDB
whatYouCanDo: Connect through the Postgres wire adapter.
Use TimescaleDB hypertables for time-series data.
Exercise time_bucket, hypertable metadata, and time-window aggregation.

engines.label: Neon
whatYouCanDo: Connect through the Postgres wire path to hosted Neon databases.
Run normal Postgres SQL and browse standard Postgres metadata.
Track branch, compute, pooling, and serverless-specific UX as hosted follow-ups.

engines.label: Supabase
whatYouCanDo: Connect to a hosted Supabase project with the dedicated engine, over TLS by default.
Use the direct, session-pooler, or transaction-pooler endpoint; the transaction pooler disables prepared statements automatically.
Browse normal Postgres schemas, tables, views, extensions, and query results.
Track RLS, pgvector and pg_graphql, auth/storage tables, and hosted connection limits as follow-ups.

features.title: Direct, session pooler, and transaction pooler modes
Hosted Postgres extensions such as pgvector and pg_graphql

engines.label: H2
whatYouCanDo: Use the experimental Postgres-wire path where H2 is configured for compatibility.
Run lightweight relational checks for Java-centric projects.
Track native H2 connection UX separately from the Postgres-wire experiment.

engines.label: MariaDB
whatYouCanDo: Connect through the MySQL wire adapter.
Run MariaDB SQL against a local container that reuses the MySQL sample schema.
Exercise JSON_VALID, JSON_VALUE, recursive CTEs, and window functions.

engines.label: TiDB
whatYouCanDo: Connect through the MySQL wire adapter.
Run TiDB SQL against a local unistore sample server.
Exercise tidb_version, shard_row_id_bits, and EXPLAIN ANALYZE.

engines.label: MongoDB
whatYouCanDo: Connect through the MongoDB adapter behind Irodori's common Connection trait.
Query by collection name or a JSON object with collection and filter.
Project documents into a tabular result and inspect collection metadata.

engines.label: Neo4j
whatYouCanDo: Connect through the Bolt adapter.
Run Cypher and return graph-like records through the result pipeline.
Use the Neo4j cheatsheet as the first graph-query reference.

engines.label: Redis
whatYouCanDo: Connect through the Redis adapter.
Model key-value browsing, command execution, and result projection.
Track key scanning, TTL, streams, pub/sub, and RedisJSON as source-specific UX work.

engines.label: Cassandra
whatYouCanDo: Connect through the Cassandra/CQL adapter.
Run CQL and inspect keyspace/table metadata.
Track partition-key-aware query help, paging, clustering keys, and ScyllaDB compatibility.

engines.label: ClickHouse
whatYouCanDo: Connect through the ClickHouse HTTP adapter.
Run analytical SQL and project HTTP results into Irodori tables.
Track MergeTree metadata, FORMAT handling, compression, and progress reporting.

engines.label: Snowflake
whatYouCanDo: Connect through the Snowflake HTTP adapter subset.
Run warehouse SQL and inspect tabular results.
Track role, warehouse, database switching, SSO, OAuth, MFA, and key-pair auth.

engines.label: BigQuery
whatYouCanDo: Connect through the BigQuery HTTP adapter.
Run GoogleSQL and project query-job results.
Track project/dataset browsing, job polling, location, billing, and IAM UX.

engines.label: Amazon Athena
whatYouCanDo: Amazon Athena is registered in Irodori's engine selector and tracked in the source catalog.
Keep Glue catalog, workgroup, result-location, and IAM requirements visible while the production connector is pending.
Use this catalog entry to attach future Athena sample projects, verification queries, and source-specific UX requirements.

features.title: Glue catalog, workgroup, and S3 result-location workflow

engines.label: Bigtable
whatYouCanDo: Connect through the Bigtable adapter.
Model instance/table/key-range browsing.
Track row-key scans, column families, filters, and IAM/project configuration.

engines.label: Cloud Spanner
whatYouCanDo: Cloud Spanner is registered in Irodori's engine selector and tracked in the source catalog.
Keep project, instance, database, IAM, GoogleSQL, and PostgreSQL-dialect requirements visible while the connector is pending.
Use this catalog entry to attach future Spanner sample projects, verification queries, and source-specific UX requirements.

engines.label: InfluxDB
whatYouCanDo: Connect through the InfluxDB HTTP adapter.
Treat InfluxDB 3 SQL as a first-class time-series query model.
Track bucket/database browsing, time-range helpers, downsampling, and tag/field completion.

engines.label: Oracle Database
whatYouCanDo: Connect through the pure-Rust thin TNS path without Oracle Instant Client.
Run Oracle SQL and browse tables/columns through the adapter.
Exercise JSON_VALUE, identity columns, FETCH FIRST, analytic functions, and DBMS_XPLAN.

engines.label: Memgraph
whatYouCanDo: Currently recognized by the engine registry but rejected at connect time.
Expected to reuse much of the Neo4j/Bolt/Cypher work.
Track Memgraph-specific metadata, procedures, and verification after routing is implemented.

engines.label: Qdrant
whatYouCanDo: Currently recognized by the engine registry but rejected at connect time.
Needs a vector-source contract before it can be a production connector.
Track collection browsing, similarity search, payload filters, and vector-result visualization.

engines.label: Milvus
whatYouCanDo: Currently recognized by the engine registry but rejected at connect time.
Needs a vector-source contract before it can be a production connector.
Track collection/schema browsing, index metadata, similarity search, and hybrid filtering.

features.title: Vector search and index metadata model

engines.label: Pinecone
whatYouCanDo: Currently recognized by the engine registry but rejected at connect time.
Needs an HTTP vector-source contract before it can be a production connector.
Track index browsing, namespaces, metadata filters, and similarity search result display.
